file.notice: Closing or reloading this page signs you out.
framed.title: Open this page on its own
framed.body: This page is shown inside another page. Sign-in is off here.
insecure.title: Open this page securely

memory.title: Can't sign in from this file

signedIn.title: Sign out first
signedIn.body: This browser holds a sign-in this page cannot use. Sign out here, then sign in again.
storage.title: Can't sign in in this browser

invalid.title: Reload this page

unreach.title: Can't reach Hoody
unreach.refusedTitle: Hoody can't open this Hub right now
unreach.network: Check your connection, then try again.
old.title: This Hub is out of date
old.body: Download the current one, then open that file instead.
old.kept: You are still signed in. Nothing was changed.
signIn.title: Sign in
other.title: Other ways to sign in
dev.lead: You finish in a new tab.
dev.title: Finish on {{site}}
dev.codeLead: Check that the page shows this code before you approve. It works for {{n}} minutes.
dev.codeLeadOne: Check that the page shows this code before you approve. It works for 1 minute.
dev.provLead: On {{site}}, press Continue, then Continue with {{provider}}.
prov.err.off: {{provider}} sign-in can't finish on this page right now. Continue on {{site}} instead.
signIn.err.off: Sign-in on {{site}} is not available right now.
signIn.err.network: Can't reach Hoody. Check your connection.
signIn.err.refused: Hoody did not start a sign-in. Try again in a moment.
signIn.err.storage: Signed in, but this browser did not keep the sign-in. Allow site data for this page, then start again.
signIn.err.noApi: This page has nothing to sign in to yet. Reload it.
signIn.err.framed: This page is shown inside another page. Open it on its own to sign in.
key.title: Sign in with an access key
key.description: A key that starts with hdy_, or the whole message it was shared in.
key.label: Access key
key.realmDescription: The 24-character realm ID this key is for.
key.pick.multi: This key opens {{n}} realms. Pick the one to open.
key.dest.title: This key opens your whole account. Open everything, or one realm?
key.confirm.name: Key name
key.err.jwt: That is a sign-in token, not an access key. Paste a key that starts with hdy_.
key.err.shape: No access key found. A key starts with hdy_.
key.err.two: The text holds two different keys. Paste one.
key.err.invalid: This key does not work: it may be wrong, turned off or expired.
key.err.noComputers: This key cannot see computers and projects, so the Hub cannot open with it.
key.err.realmNeeded: Name the realm this key is for.
key.err.realmMismatch: This key is not for that realm. Check the realm ID.
key.err.realmShape: A realm ID is 24 characters, 0-9 and a-f.
key.err.realmUnsupported: Hoody does not open single realms from here. Choose Everything, or sign in another way.
key.err.offline: Can't reach Hoody. Check your connection, then try again.
key.err.network: Hoody does not accept this key from this network.
key.err.unavailable: The account this key belongs to cannot be used.
key.err.storage: This browser did not keep the sign-in. Allow site data for this page, then try again.
key.err.stale: Someone signed in or out in another tab meanwhile. Check the key again.
key.err.signedIn: This browser is already signed in. Reload the page.
key.err.framed: This page is shown inside another page. Open it on its own to use a key.
key.confirm.label: What this key opens
key.confirm.title: Open the Hub with this key?
key.err.unready: This page did not load completely. Reload it.
key.confirm.warn: You will act as {{owner}}, with only what this key allows. Anyone holding the key can do the same.
pw.err.empty: Enter your email or user name and your password.
pw.err.credentials: That email or user name and password do not match.
pw.err.unverified: Confirm your email address first: open the link in the email we sent you, then sign in here.
pw.err.retry: Too many tries. Wait {{s}} seconds, then try again.
pw.err.retryOne: Too many tries. Wait 1 second, then try again.
pw.err.retryMinutes: Too many tries. Wait {{m}} minutes, then try again.
pw.err.retryLater: Too many tries. Try again later.
pw.err.network: Can't reach Hoody. Check your connection, then try again.
pw.err.unavailable: Hoody could not sign you in just now. Try again in a moment.
pw.err.framed: This page is shown inside another page. Open it on its own to sign in.
tfa.title: Two-step check
tfa.lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a backup code.
tfa.label: Code
tfa.err.otp: That code did not work. Check it and try again.
tfa.err.expired: The sign-in took too long. Enter your password again.
tfa.err.ended: This sign-in can't be finished. Sign in again.
forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: We email you a link. Set a new password there, then come back and sign in.
forgot.sent: If {{email}} has a Hoody account, a reset link is on its way.
forgot.err.address: Enter the email address of your Hoody account.
up.title: Create your account
up.lead: We email you a link to confirm the address. Then you sign in here.
up.rule: At least 12 characters, using three of: capital letters, small letters, digits, symbols.
up.inviteLead: Hoody asks for an invite code for a free server. You can also add one later.
prov.legal: By continuing, you agree to our {{terms}} and {{privacy}}.
up.legal: By creating an account, you agree to our {{terms}} and {{privacy}}.
up.closed: Hoody is not taking new accounts right now. You can request access at access@hoody.com.
up.checkLead: Open the check in a new tab, make sure it shows the same code, and finish it there. This page carries on by itself.
up.waiting: Waiting for the check to finish…
up.sent: If {{email}} can get a new account, a link to confirm it is on its way. Open it, then come back and sign in.
up.resent: Asked again. The email can take a few minutes.
up.err.rule: This password does not follow the rule above.
up.err.invalid: Hoody did not accept these details. Check the address and the password, then try again.
up.err.domain: Hoody does not accept addresses from this email provider. Use another address.
up.err.paused: Hoody has paused new accounts for now. Try again later, or request access at access@hoody.com.
up.err.challenge: The check ran out. Try again.
up.err.unavailable: Hoody could not create the account just now. Try again in a moment.
